newsitem.title: UK: London Clubs 'disappointed' by UK DTI block.
newsitem.headline: London Clubs 'disappointed' by UK DTI block.

text.p: Britain's London Clubs International said it was disappointed by a UK government decision to block its plans to acquire rival casino operator Capital Corporation Plc.

"London Clubs International...is obviously disappointed that it will be prevented from making a new offer for Capital Corporation, which it believes was in the best interest of both sets of shareholders," the company said in a statement.

"The company continues to enjoy excellent prospects as a result of its successful overseas strategy and the recent successful applications for new licences for (London) premises at both 50 St.James's and Old Park Lane," it added.
The UK government ruled on Tuesday that a merger would be against the public interest as it would give the enlarged company 80 percent of the business in London's up-market casinos.
